jobDescription: Principal AI SDLC Acceleration Architects to help customers prove the value of Velocity AI SDLC through hands-on architecture, AI-enabled engineering, and measurable delivery acceleration. This role is for senior architects and engineers who can modernize software delivery using AI. The focus is not only on accelerating traditional Scrum-based SDLC, but also on helping customers adopt intent-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, automation, and human governance turn business or product intent into validated software outcomes. The ideal candidate is a hands-on builder, deep architect, strong communicator, and first-principles thinker who can engage both engineering teams and executive stakeholders. Must-Have Qualifications and Experience Experience: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, architecture, product engineering, platform engineering, solution architecture, or similar roles, with strong product-side delivery experience. Technical Fluency: Hands-on fluency with AI development tools, IDE-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-enabled software delivery, with the ability to build, evaluate, and explain working solutions. AI Governance: Strong understanding of AI governance, human-in-the-loop controls, responsible AI, security, observability, and production readiness for AI-enabled systems. Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to identify SDLC bottlenecks and opportunities for AI-led acceleration. Design and deliver working proofs using Velocity AI SDLC, modern AI development tools, agentic workflows, and automation. Help customers move from traditional ticket- and sprint-based delivery toward intent-driven delivery loops that can generate plans, code, tests, documentation, and validation artifacts. Define and measure acceleration outcomes such as reduced cycle time, faster story-to-code conversion, improved test generation, faster code review, reduced handoffs, and improved release readiness. Present technical approach, architecture, proof results, business impact, and adoption recommendations to both technical and executive audiences.
